description: Log today's line to keep the streak alive. Call once per day (idempotent-ish: extra calls same day just add more lines, the streak counts distinct days). Requires the api_token from start_streak. Returns the updated streak and public url.

api_token.description: The secret token returned by start_streak.

body.description: One honest line about today (max 240 chars).

name: log_today
